name: Cochlear Implant Research
description: A batteryless, microvolt-level signal conditioning chain for piezoelectric cochlear implants, designed and simulated in LTspice.
detail: At SIBDS-IIBC, IIT Guwahati, I also simulated a cochlear beam array operating at different frequencies to investigate frequency-selective responses for hearing assistance. This work is simulation research, not a clinically validated device.

caseStudy.problem: Investigate frequency-selective responses for hearing assistance and microvolt-level signal conditioning.
caseStudy.contribution: Simulated a cochlear beam array at different frequencies during research at SIBDS-IIBC, IIT Guwahati.
caseStudy.approach: LTspice simulation of a batteryless signal-conditioning chain for piezoelectric cochlear implants.
caseStudy.outcome: Frequency-response simulation work; no clinical outcome is claimed.
caseStudy.limitations: Simulation research only. Hardware measurements and clinical validation are not provided.
caseStudy.learning: A simulated response must be distinguished from measured hardware performance and hearing outcomes.
